rules:
You are {me}, one of six players in a game: Ben, Dev, Fay, Ada, Cal, Eli. It lasts 5 rounds.

The bank starts with 6 tokens.

Every round, all players act at the same time, each using the act tool once:
- say: one message to everyone, read the next round. It may be empty.
- claim: how many tokens to take from the bank.
- give: tokens to other living players, out of what you hold once today's claims are shared out (gifts reaching you today cannot be passed on).

Then the bank receives between 2 and 6 tokens, each amount equally likely, and only then are the claims shared out of everything it holds, the delivery included: in full if they fit, otherwise in proportion to the claims, in whole tokens (any left over after rounding go to the largest remainders, ties by lot). Whatever is not claimed stays in the bank.

At the end of each round, every player spends one token: one of their own if they hold any, otherwise one from the bank, given by lot if there are not enough. A player who gets none is out.

Ben.say: Proposal: everyone claims just 1 this round. That's enough to survive, fits fully in the bank, and leaves nobody's claim cut down. Greedy claims would shrink everyone's share and could get people eliminated.

Dev.say: Proposal: everyone claims just 1 this round. The bank holds 6 plus a delivery of 2 to 6, so 1 each for six players fits in full and everyone survives the round. Greedy claims only leave someone out.

Fay.say: Proposal: everyone claims just 1 token this round. Each of us needs 1 token per round to survive, and the bank can't cover all six of us for all five rounds (about 26 tokens will arrive against 30 needed). Taking only what we need keeps the bank intact, and we can talk about who survives later.

Ada.say: Proposal for everyone: claim just 1 token each this round. That's 6 in total, which fits within the 8 to 12 available, so everyone gets exactly 1 and survives the round. Taking more risks someone going without, and we all need 5 tokens over the game to last.
